coverage.summary: Non-exhaustive, source-backed catalog checked on 2026-10-01. It contains 138 series records and 737 figure records: 722 named figures read from the official Sonny Angel product archive (Regular current and pre-refine lineups, Gift, HIPPERS, Limited, Artist Collection, Master Collection and Others pages), four figures named in an official 2016 announcement, and 11 secret/Robby figures named only by a third-party article or a resale listing. The official site says the archive introduces 650+ figures and unofficial trackers claim 1,000+, so this file must not be presented as a complete list. Official SKU/JAN identifiers are recorded on series only, scoped to the randomized blind box or assortment they identify; no per-figure identifier was found. Prices are individual dated observations (sold, asking or retail), not appraisals: only two completed sales and 14 asking listings could be attributed to exact listing URLs, and blind-box retail prices are recorded for 18 series. 203 figures have at least one price observation (265 observations total), mostly series-level retail prices repeated on each applicable figure.
gaps: No official machine-readable export exists; lineups were transcribed from official archive pages as text. Figure names and the pairing of names to image URLs follow page order and were not visually verified, which matters most where image filenames are opaque (for example SA_447_01.jpg).

Name normalization: run-together archive spellings (GreenPepper, BokChoy, BigApple) are written with spaces and obvious official typos are corrected, with the official spelling kept in the figure notes.

Image URLs point at the official site and were read from official pages but were not individually requested; Dreams Inc. reserves rights in this imagery and no reuse permission was found, so links can break or need replacing with licensed images.

Secret and Robby figures are missing for most series. The official archive does not name them; the 11 included (a secret and a Robby each for the Fruit, Flower, Marine, Sweets and Vegetable Series from one third-party article, plus a Cat Life Robby known from a resale listing title) are flagged in their notes, have no images, and are attached to the current lineups without confirmation of edition. The HIPPERS Dreaming secret Unicorn reported in work-item research and any Strawberry Love secret are not recorded because the third-party retailer pages that might name them returned HTTP 429 during this check. Animal Series 1-4 secrets and Robbys are omitted because sources conflict (a third-party article says a unicorn secret and an orange Robby for all four, while a resale listing reported in research describes a blue Animal Series 4 Robby).

Nineteen series known only from official announcement titles (Halloween 2015/2018, Easter 2016-2018, Christmas 2015, Chocolate 2016, Valentine's Day Chocolate 2015, 11th/12th Anniversary, Beach Hawaii 2015, Summer Caribbean Sea 2016, Chinoiserie, H Family, STEAM ARTS trophy, 15th and 20th Anniversary Limited Editions, Laduree Christmas Ornament, Collector's Trophy) have a series record but no figures, because their lineups could not be read; Halloween 2016 is the one exception with four named figures.
Summer Vacation Series 2017 and Summer Series 2018 show 12 unnamed figure images each on the official archive; the images are kept on the series record and no figure names were invented.

Later additions are not itemized: six secret figures added to Halloween Series 2021 (announced 2022-09-09), four figures added to the Japanese Good Luck Series (announced 2023-07-10), new Bobbing Head animals (2015), special-color campaign figures, and a possible twelfth Advent Calendar 2025 figure.
Release years come from the official archive heading or a dated official announcement title; where neither was available releaseYear is null rather than inferred from image upload paths.

Identifiers cover only six series (Animal Series 2, 3 and 4, HIPPERS, HIPPERS Dreaming, HIPPERS Cherry Blossom). The official Japan and US stores returned HTTP 429 during this check, so Animal Series 2 and HIPPERS Dreaming identifiers and prices rely on the work-item research record rather than a fresh read. Discontinued releases have no identifiers.

Resale evidence remains thin. Mercari and Depop observations are seller asking prices, not completed sales; listing condition and authenticity are seller claims, and unavailable shipping or fees are called out per observation. eBay returned HTTP 403, so the three eBay observations rest on the work-item research record. Five further sold observations reported there (Strawberry Love Fawn USD 22 on 2026-07-22; HIPPERS Dreaming secret Unicorn USD 75 on 2026-07-05; Flower Series secret Bee USD 150 on 2026-06-28; Animal Series 4 blue Robby USD 85 on 2026-09-26; 2018 Summer Series Robby USD 400 on 2026-06-12) are not in any prices array because their exact listing URLs were not retained.

Sold prices exclude shipping, item condition was not captured, and Dreams Inc. does not authenticate secondary-market goods; one sale is not a market value. Retail prices are blind-box prices for a random figure, repeated on each figure of the series, and are not figure-specific.
Status is 'current' only where an official shop listing was seen for the series on the check date; limited and collaboration releases are 'unknown' because the archive does not state availability.
